INSERT INTO card_bill ( user_id, connection_id, seqno, charge_amount, charge_day, charge_month, paid_out_date ) VALUES
( #{bill.userId}, #{bill.connectionId}, #{bill.seqno}, #{bill.chargeAmount}, #{bill.chargeDay}, #{bill.chargeMonth}, #{bill.paidOutDate} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE charge_amount = VALUES(charge_amount), charge_day = VALUES(charge_day), paid_out_date = VALUES(paid_out_date), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
